OTVARANJE_OBRADE.NAME: OTVARANJE_OBRADE
OTVARANJE_OBRADE.CAPTION: Otvaranje nove obrade
OTVARANJE_OBRADE.ONLOAD: select 1 as 'dodajsve',year(getdate()) as 'godina',month(getdate()) as 'mjesec','0' as 'danod','0' as 'dando',max(rbr) as 'rbr' from oopobrade where oznaka = rtrim(ltrim(@@godina)) + right('00' + rtrim(@@mjesec),2)

DJELATNIK_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE.NAME: DJELATNIK_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE
DJELATNIK_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE.CAPTION: Kopiranje stavaka iz druge obrade za @@djelatnik
DJELATNIK_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE.ONLOAD: select @@id as oopobradeglaid,g.hrkadroviid as hrkadroviid,1 as odaberisve,1 as indsati,1 as indiznos,1 as indbodovi,1 as indpostotak,1 as indorgshema,1 as indrelacije,1 as indrazdoblje ,k.prezime + ' ' + k.ime as djelatnik from totalgenmultiselecttemp t inner join oopobradegla g on t.id=g.oopobradeglaid inner join hrkadrovi k on g.hrkadroviid=k.hrkadroviid where t.operateriid=@@operateriid and t.hostname=host_name() and t.susersname=suser_sname()

MULTIBLUE_KOPIRANJE_STAVAKA.NAME: MULTIBLUE_KOPIRANJE_STAVAKA
MULTIBLUE_KOPIRANJE_STAVAKA.CAPTION: Prolazna forma
MULTIBLUE_KOPIRANJE_STAVAKA.ONLOAD:
select COUNT(*) as broj ,case when count(*) = 1 then 'DJELATNIK_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE' else 'DJELATNICI_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE' end as 'formakopiraj'
FROM TotalGenMultiSelectTemp t where t.operateriid=@@operateriid and t.hostname=host_name() and t.susersname=suser_sname()

DJELATNICI_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE.NAME: DJELATNICI_KOPIRAJ_STAVKE

INPUT.NAME: griddjelatnici
INPUT.CAPTION: Odabrani djelatnici
INPUT.SQL: select t.id,'Rbr0400' = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (order by k.prezime,k.ime,k.oib),'Djelatnik2500' = k.prezime + ' ' + k.ime ,'OIB2000' = k.OIB from TotalGenMultiSelectTemp t inner join oopobradegla g on g.OOPObradeGlaId = t.ID inner join hrkadrovi k on g.HRKadroviId = k.HRKadroviId where t.operateriid = @@operateriid
